title: 2026 Minimal Change Disease (微小病變腎病) 分子機轉、病理特徵、次發性原因與 KDIGO 指引實戰

sections.title: Section 1: Molecular Pathogenesis, Charge Barrier & Podocyte Effacement
sections.content:
### 拓撲陣列 (Topology Mapping Matrix)
* **Glomerular Filtration Barrier Architecture**:
  - **Fenestrated Endothelium**: 阻擋 Cellular Components (RBCs, WBCs, Platelets)。
  - **Glomerular Basement Membrane (GBM)**: 包含 Type IV Collagen, Laminin, and Heparan Sulfate Proteoglycans (HSPGs)。提供 Negative Polyanionic Charge Barrier，排除 Albumin 等負電大分子。
  - **Podocyte Foot Processes & Slit Diaphragms**: 由 Nephrin, Podocin, CD2AP, NPHS1, and NPHS2 等關鍵蛋白質構成。為最終的 Size-Selective Barrier。
* **Circulating Permeability Factors & Pathogenesis in MCD**:
  - **T-cell Dysfunction Hypothesis**: T-cell 異常活化產生 Circulating Cytokines (如 IL-13, c-Maf)，改變 Podocyte 基因表現與 Cytoskeleton。
  - **Angiopoietin-like 4 (ANGPTL4)**: Sialylated ANGPTL4 於 Podocyte 爆發性過度表達，誘發 Subepithelial Charge Neutralization 與 Foot Process Effacement。
  - **CD80 (B7-1) Expression**: Podocyte 受到 Stress 或 Cytokine 刺激後上調 CD80，擾亂 β1 Integrin 與 Podocyte Adhesion。
  - **Selective Albuminuria**: Charge Barrier 與 Slit Diaphragm 受損，致使 Albumin 自由過濾，但較大分子 (IgG, α2-Macroglobulin) 仍被排除。

### 鑑別對比表 (High-Yield Differential Comparison Table)
| Pathophysiological Aspect | Minimal Change Disease (MCD) | Focal Segmental Glomerulosclerosis (FSGS) |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Primary Mechanism** | Circulating cytokines & Reversible podocyte effacement | Sustained podocyte depletion, detachment & Sclerosis |
| **Proteinuria Selectivity** | Highly Selective (Albuminuria with High Selectivity Index < 0.1) | Non-selective (Albumin + IgG + Large proteins) |
| **Charge Barrier Polyanion Loss** | Marked loss of Heparan Sulfate Negative Charges | Structural pore enlargement & Endothelial/GBM destruction |
| **Reversibility of Effacement** | Complete reversal after Corticosteroid Remission | Progressive structural scarring & Hyalinosis |

### 機轉決策樹 (Pathophysiological Decision Tree)
```
[Systemic T-cell Dysfunction / Environmental Trigger]
       │
       ▼
[Secretion of Circulating Permeability Factors (IL-13, ANGPTL4)]
       │
       ▼
[Podocyte Cytoskeletal Rearrangement & Foot Process Effacement]
       │
       ▼
[Loss of GBM Negative Polyanionic Charge Barrier (Heparan Sulfate)]
       │
       ▼
[Severe Selective Albuminuria ──► Hypoalbuminemia ──► Nephrotic Edema]
```

### 觀念避坑指南 (Conceptual Trap Analysis)
1. **Selectivity Index Trap**: MCD 的蛋白尿為 Highly Selective (主要是 Albumin 過濾，IgG 通過極少)；若出現顯著 Non-selective Proteinuria (IgG / Albumin Ratio 增加)，需高度懷疑 FSGS 或 Secondary Glomerulonephritis。
2. **Complement & Immune Complex Trap**: MCD 的致病核心是 Podocyte Effacement 與 Charge Barrier 失效，並非 Glomerular Immune Complex Deposition，因此 Serum Complement Levels (C3, C4) 一律維持正常。

sections.title: Section 2: Histopathological Diagnosis & Microscopic Variants
sections.content:
### 拓撲陣列 (Topology Mapping Matrix)
* **Diagnostic Triad under Kidney Biopsy**:
  - **Light Microscopy (LM)**: Glomeruli 呈現 completely normal 外觀 (無 Hypercellularity, 無 Mesangial Matrix Expansion, 無 GBM Thickening)。Proximal Tubules 可見 Lipid Droplets ("Lipoid Nephrosis")。
  - **Immunofluorescence (IF)**: 呈 Negative 或 Pauci-immune (無顯著 IgG, IgA, IgM, C3, C1q 沉積)。少數案件可見微量 Trace Mesangial IgM/C3。
  - **Electron Microscopy (EM)**: 唯一具診斷性的絕招！顯現 Diffuse Foot Process Effacement (Podocyte Flattening and Retraction) 及 Microvillous Transformation of Podocyte Cytoplasm。
* **Important Pathological Differential Diagnostics**:
  - **FSGS Tip Lesion Variant**: Segmental Sclerosis 局限於 Proximal Tubule 口部，早期切片可能因 Sampling Error 誤判為 MCD。
  - **IgM Nephropathy**: LM 正常或輕微 Mesangial Proliferation，但 IF 呈現 Diffuse Mesangial IgM Deposition (通常對 Corticosteroids 反應較差)。
  - **C1q Nephropathy**: IF 顯現 Dominant Mesangial C1q Staining，臨床常呈 Steroid Resistance。

### 鑑別對比表 (High-Yield Differential Comparison Table)
| Biopsy Modality | Minimal Change Disease (MCD) | FSGS (Focal Segmental Glomerulosclerosis) | Membranous Nephropathy (MN) |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Light Microscopy** | Completely Normal Glomeruli | Segmental Sclerosis & Hyalinosis in subset of glomeruli | Diffuse GBM Thickening & Spikes on Silver Stain |
| **Immunofluorescence** | Negative / Pauci-immune | Segmental C3 and IgM in sclerotic segments | Global Granular Subepithelial IgG4 & C3 |
| **Electron Microscopy** | Diffuse Foot Process Effacement ONLY | Foot Process Effacement + Segmental GBM Collapse | Subepithelial Electron-Dense Deposits |

### 機轉決策樹 (Pathophysiological Decision Tree)
```
[Renal Biopsy in Patient with Nephrotic Syndrome]
       │
       ├─► Light Microscopy: Normal Glomeruli & Open Capillaries
       │     │
       │     ├─► Immunofluorescence: Negative / Pauci-immune
       │     │     │
       │     │     └─► Electron Microscopy: Diffuse Foot Process Effacement
       │     │           │
       │     │           └─► Diagnosis: Minimal Change Disease (MCD)
       │     │
       │     └─► Immunofluorescence: Dominant C1q or IgM ──► C1q/IgM Nephropathy
       │
       └─► Focal Segmental Sclerosis / Collapse ──► FSGS Variant (Tip / Collapsing)
```

### 觀念避坑指南 (Conceptual Trap Analysis)
1. **Sampling Error Trap**: 成人 Nephrotic Syndrome 切片若 LM 看到 Normal Glomeruli，必須切選足夠的 Juxtamedullary Glomeruli；若切片取樣不足，可能把早期 FSGS 誤診為 MCD。
2. **Lipoid Nephrosis Terminology**: 歷史名稱 "Lipoid Nephrosis" 來自於 Proximal Tubular Epithelial Cells 吸收過濾之 Lipids/Cholesterol 形成之 Vacuoles，並非代表 Glomerulus 本身有 Lipid Deposition。

sections.title: Section 3: Secondary Etiologies, Drugs & Environmental Triggers
sections.content:
### 拓撲陣列 (Topology Mapping Matrix)
* **Secondary Causes of Minimal Change Disease**:
  - **Hematologic Malignancies**: **Hodgkin Lymphoma** (最經典強大之關聯，與 Reed-Sternberg Cells 分泌之 Cytokines 相關)；Non-Hodgkin Lymphoma, Chronic Lymphocytic Leukemia (CLL)。
  - **Pharmaceutical Agents**:
    1. **NSAIDs (Nonsteroidal Anti-inflammatory Drugs)**: 經典引發 MCD 伴隨 Acute Interstitial Nephritis (AIN)。
    2. **Lithium**: 用於 Bipolar Disorder，可同時致使 MCD 與 Nephrogenic Diabetes Insipidus (NDI)。
    3. **Interferon-alpha / Interferon-beta**: 用於 Viral Hepatitis 或 Multiple Sclerosis。
    4. **Antibiotics**: Ampicillin, Rifampin, Trimethadione。
    5. **Gold Salts & Tiopronin**.
  - **Hypersensitivity & Allergies**: Bee Stings (Hymenoptera Venom), Pollen, Poison Ivy, Shellfish/Food Allergies, Dermatitis Herpetiformis。
  - **Other Clinical Associations**: Following Allogeneic Stem Cell Transplantation (Graft-versus-Host Disease), SLE, Parasitic Infections (Echinococcus, Strongyloides)。

### 鑑別對比表 (High-Yield Differential Comparison Table)
| Secondary Trigger Category | Specific Etiology / Drug | Key Clinical Feature & Pathological Coupling |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Malignancy** | Hodgkin Lymphoma | Proteinuria correlates with tumor burden; remits after Chemotherapy |
| **Analgesics** | NSAIDs | Combined MCD + Acute Interstitial Nephritis (Heavy proteinuria + Eosinophiluria) |
| **Psychotropic** | Lithium | Nephrotic Syndrome (MCD) + Polyuria/Polydipsia (NDI & Microcysts) |
| **Envenomation / Allergy** | Bee Stings / Hymenoptera | Acute onset of Nephrotic Syndrome within days of allergic challenge |

### 機轉決策樹 (Pathophysiological Decision Tree)
```
[Adult Patient Presenting with Sudden-Onset Nephrotic Syndrome]
       │
       ├─► Check Medication History
       │     ├─► Chronic NSAID Use ──► Stop NSAID (Evaluates MCD + AIN)
       │     └─► Lithium / Interferon ──► Dose Adjustment & Monitoring
       │
       ├─► Physical Exam & B-symptoms (Fever, Night Sweats, Weight Loss)
       │     └─► Lymphadenopathy / Splenomegaly ──► Screen for Hodgkin Lymphoma
       │
       └─► Environmental History
             └─► Recent Bee Stings / Insect Bites ──► Post-envenomation MCD
```

### 觀念避坑指南 (Conceptual Trap Analysis)
1. **NSAID Dual Nephrotoxicity Trap**: NSAIDs 引起的 腎病變最經典組合為 Minimal Change Disease 併發 Acute Interstitial Nephritis (MCD + AIN)，切片會同時看到 Podocyte Effacement 與 Interstitial Inflammatory Infiltrates。
2. **Hodgkin Lymphoma Correlation Trap**: 若 Hodgkin Lymphoma 患者出現 Nephrotic Syndrome，首選病理診斷為 MCD (而不是 FSGS 或 MN)；隨著 Lymphoma 治療成功，蛋白尿亦會自行緩解。

sections.title: Section 4: KDIGO Guidelines & Immunosuppressive Management
sections.content:
### 拓撲陣列 (Topology Mapping Matrix)
* **Initial Corticosteroid Therapy (KDIGO Guidelines)**:
  - **First-Line Agent**: Oral Prednisone or Prednisolone 1 mg/kg/day (maximum 80 mg/day) or 2 mg/kg every other day (maximum 120 mg every other day).
  - **Duration**: Continue high-dose Corticosteroids for at least 4 weeks if Complete Remission is achieved, up to a maximum of 16 weeks if response is delayed.
  - **Tapering Phase**: After Complete Remission (<0.3 g/day proteinuria), slowly taper over 2 to 6 months.
* **Relapse Definitions & Patterns (Brenner Box 31.5)**:
  - **Complete Remission**: Urinary Protein-to-Creatinine Ratio (UPCR) <0.3 g/g or negative/trace dipstick for 3 consecutive days.
  - **Frequent Relapses**: ≥2 relapses within 6 months of initial response, or ≥4 relapses within 12 months.
  - **Steroid Dependence**: 2 consecutive relapses during corticosteroid taper or within 2 weeks of discontinuation.
  - **Steroid Resistance**: Absence of remission despite 16 weeks of high-dose corticosteroids.
* **Second-Line Steroid-Sparing Agents**:
  - **Cyclophosphamide**: Oral 2 to 2.5 mg/kg/day for 8 to 12 weeks (Monitor cumulative dose <150 mg/kg to prevent Gonadal Toxicity and Malignancy).
  - **Rituximab**: Anti-CD20 Monoclonal Antibody. 衍生為 Frequent Relapse 及 Steroid Dependent MCD 之首選替代方案。
  - **Calcineurin Inhibitors (CNIs)**: Tacrolimus (0.05-0.1 mg/kg/day) or Cyclosporine (3-5 mg/kg/day). 高緩解率但停藥後 Relapse Rate 高，需維持治療 1-2 年。
  - **Mycophenolate Mofetil (MMF)**: 1-2 g/day for at least 1-2 years.

### 鑑別對比表 (High-Yield Differential Comparison Table)
| Steroid-Sparing Agent | Dosing Regimen | Major Clinical Advantage | Key Adverse Effect / Limitation |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Oral Cyclophosphamide** | 2-2.5 mg/kg/day for 8-12 weeks | Long-term sustained remission after 12-week course | Infertility / Alopecia / Hemorrhagic Cystitis |
| **Rituximab** | 375 mg/m² IV (1-2 doses) | Avoids systemic steroid/CNI toxicity, highly effective | Infusion reactions / Progressive Multifocal Leukoencephalopathy |
| **Tacrolimus / Cyclosporine** | Trough target: Tac (4-8 ng/mL) / Csa (100-175 ng/mL) | Rapid proteinuria reduction in steroid-dependent cases | Nephrotoxicity (CNI Arteriolopathy) & High Relapse upon withdrawal |

### 機轉決策樹 (Pathophysiological Decision Tree)
```
[Confirmed Diagnosis of Adult Minimal Change Disease]
       │
       ▼
[Initial High-Dose Corticosteroids: Prednisone 1 mg/kg/day (max 80 mg)]
       │
       ├─► Remission within 4-16 weeks ──► Slow Taper over 2-6 months
       │     │
       │     ├─► No Relapse / Infrequent Relapse ──► Standard Care
       │     │
       │     └─► Frequent Relapses / Steroid Dependence
       │           │
       │           ├─► Preferred: Rituximab or Cyclophosphamide
       │           └─► Alternative: Calcineurin Inhibitor (Tacrolimus / Csa) or MMF
       │
       └─► No Remission after 16 weeks (Steroid Resistance)
             └─► Re-evaluate Biopsy (Rule out FSGS) & Initiate CNI / Genetic Testing
```

### 觀念避坑指南 (Conceptual Trap Analysis)
1. **Steroid Resistance Biopsy Trap**: 若成人 MCD 患者接受 16 週 High-dose Steroids 依然完全無效 (Steroid-Resistant)，第一時間必須重新審視或進行 Repeat Kidney Biopsy，極可能為 Sampling Error 遺漏之 FSGS。
2. **Cyclophosphamide Cumulative Dose Trap**: Cyclophosphamide 治療切勿超過 12 週，累積劑量應低於 150 mg/kg，以防併發 Premature Ovarian Failure, Azoospermia, 及 Secondary Malignancy (Urothelial Carcinoma)。
